A little about me

Care in the details.
Curiosity everywhere.

My work connects research, interaction, and visual design. I’m drawn to experiences that make something unfamiliar feel approachable—whether that’s a child’s first reading game or a technical training tool.

My background spans digital learning, brand systems, and physical products. Across each, I bring the same interest: understanding what people need, then making the next step feel clear.
